faq.Do I need to know how to code to contrib: No. Pages are plain Markdown files. If you can write a document and open a pull request on GitHub, you can contribute.
faq.Where do I put images?: Put them in public/content/<project>/ and reference them as /content/<project>/<file> in your Markdown.
faq.Why does my page crash the build with a: Local pages are compiled as MDX, so a bare curly brace or less-than sign in normal text can break them. Wrap code in backticks or escape the character with a backslash.
faq.Can I document a project without copying: Yes. Drop a github.txt file containing a GitHub folder URL into a content folder and the wiki will pull in that whole folder automatically.
faq.How do I make a page that only shows up: Create the Markdown file but leave it out of sidebar.json. It will still be routable, searchable and listed in the sitemap.
